Class ConvertType

java.lang.Object
dev.visdb.seesaw.datasources.ConvertType
public class ConvertType extends Object
Different database jdbc drivers support different type conversion; this utility class juggles types around.

TODO: Consider situations where JDBC does the requested conversion and so nothing to do. Maybe such a thing is checked before doing the convert methods. Like "verifyConvertToType()" below; "checkDriverConvertToType()".

    • convertToType

      public static Object convertToType(Object value, JDBCType jdbcType) throws SQLException
      Convert the specified object to the object type for the specified JDBCType. This is not just casting; for example Boolen to Integer. The same object may be returned.

      Note the spec B.2 vs B.4 updater methods vs setObject; and B.5 for setObject when a target type is specified. TODO: Is this is for when a target JDBCtype is NOT specified or in the setObject (not appendix B.5).???

      Parameters:
      value -
      jdbcType -
      Returns:
      Throws:
      SQLException
      See Also:
      • JDBC 4.3 Specification Appendix B.4 Java Object Types Mapped to JDBC Types

    • castJDBCToJava

      public static Object[] castJDBCToJava(JDBCType jdbcType, Object[] objects) throws SQLException
      Copy the elements of the objects array into into an array of the correct type for the JDBCTyped objects.

      If an array or even a collection of the accurate type is desired, you can do the follow which is type safe, no compiler warnings. There will be an exception if something is afoul. 

      Object[] arr = f(); // But I "know" the elements are Integer
Integer[] newarr = (Integer[]) castJDBCToJava(JDBCType.INTEGER, arr);
List<Integer> properList = Arrays.asList(newarr);
      Parameters:
      jdbcType - cast objects to this JDBCType
      objects - array of objects to cast
      Returns:
      array of corresponding type to the cast input objects
      Throws:
      SQLException - This exception wraps a ClassCastException
